Need some info on Vive. How does it connect to PC?

The headset plugs a bundle of cables into this little adapter box. From that box, 1 USB & 1 HDMI plugs into your computer. The little box also has an AC adapter that has to be plugged into an outlet.

Each controller also comes with a charger cable and adapter.

You'll also need to plug in the 2 camera mounts and either mount them on a wall or support them on probably something like camera tripods. Each of these have to be plugged into an outlet as well. They communicate wirelessly, but you can connect them to each other with a provided 25' (guesstimate) headphone jack-like cable if they're having trouble communicating.

The headset also comes with a headphone jack for sound, so you'll want a pair of headphones as well. The jack comes out of the headset. It feeds off the audio signal from the HDMI connection, shows up as a different audio device in windows, and you can configure the Vive to automatically switch this device to default when you turn it on, and switch back to something else when you turn it off.
